summary: Bound cache resources and safely reuse SQLite connections and credential fingerprints

delivery.outcome: Publish the user-handed-off 770343a cache performance work with bounded synchronization resources and credential-rotation correctness, preserving canonical HTTP caching.
nonGoals: No dependency or governance changes, Rust extension, credential values, production runtime deployment or discarded history.

architecture.decision: Reuse one SQLite connection per cache instance/thread/PID with explicit close; retain SQLite durability defaults. Weakly retain only live single-flight locks. Cache only bounded credential fingerprints keyed by file identity and metadata with stable-read verification. Preserve ProCache alias from handed-off commit.
interfaceChanges: Add ProCache alias and explicit current-thread connection lifecycle.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert; original commit remains in local annotated recovery tag and verified full-history bundle.

validation.evidence: Connections are reused, isolated by thread and refreshed after fork; closing and reopen preserve persistence.
Single-flight remains correct under real contention without retaining locks for past unique keys.
Unchanged configuration avoids repeated reads; atomic replacement, same-size rewrite and missing/unreadable/racing configuration cannot reuse an incorrect account.
All regressions and governance pass; independent exact-head protected publication succeeds.
